content.value: For a homogeneous nucleation, undercooling of the order of $2 7 0 \mathrm { { ^ \circ C } }$ is required for liquid (06) aluminum. Determine the size of the critical radius of the spherical embryo and the energy change associated with the process. If the volume of one aluminum atom is about 1.25 x 10-23cm³, calculate the probable number of copper atoms required to form such embryo. Given data: Te = 660°C, .γsl = 135 erg/cm2, L = 1.47x1010 erg/cm³.
